answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 2743 Country: Pakistan Title: Question regarding clothing. It is better not to wear cloths style of the non Muslims? Therefore cloths such as the jeans, underwear, are not allowed or not sunnah? Question: Question regarding clothing. It is better not to wear cloths style of the non Muslims? Therefore cloths such as the jeans, underwear, are not allowed or not sunnah? Answer ID: 2743 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 105/105=L) Nowadays wearing jeans is common, therefore it is no more tashabbuh (imitating the unbelievers), but certainly it is the dress of irreligious people, therefore it should be avoided. However, this dress is allowed only when the body structures are not displayed which are to be kept hidden, otherwise wearing jeans will be disallowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
